clips.title: The story
paras: Black worgs prowl Malden's Orchard in northern Silverpine Forest. The ruined farmstead takes its name from Malden, the human farmer who fled during the Scourge invasion of Lordaeron. Its dark evergreen trees grow wild, and a crumbling cottage once sheltered a Forsaken scout cut off from his unit.

Malden's Orchard once sent fresh fruit to the towns of Lordaeron. Malden, a human farmer, tended the land before the Third War. When the Scourge swept through the kingdom, he abandoned the farm and fled the plague. Since then, Silverpine's dark mists have closed over the orchard. Its evergreen trees go unpruned, and fruit rots on blighted boughs. Wild predators have claimed the plot.
